aliases: QTS Hands Mill Highway/Campbell Road campus
status_as_of_cutoff: State announcement confirms QTS selected York County for a campus. Phase 2 also identified a 2026 PSC utility order and reporting of site-preparation support, but no building-level permit, CO, construction completion, energization, or service evidence was located.

actions.government_body: South Carolina Governor / state economic-development announcement
actions.result_status: State announced QTS's first South Carolina operations in York County, a $1 billion investment near Hands Mill Highway and Campbell Road. Announcement is not local zoning or building approval.
actions.access_caveat: State announcement; local permit and utility records were not attached.
actions.evidence_note: Announcement kept separate from approval and construction.

actions.government_body: Not a government action; commercial press
actions.result_status: Commercial reporting described an $8 billion QTS project and York County site-preparation support. The report is not treated as proof of a permit, vote, or completed construction.
actions.access_caveat: Press source; underlying county grant/agreement and permit documents were not located.
actions.evidence_note: Reported advancement, not verified building approval.

actions.result_status: Order 2025-161 granted a certificate for two double-circuit 230-kV lines and associated facilities in Allison Creek Industrial Park, York County, to serve a new industrial customer identified in the order as QTS Data Centers. The order is utility infrastructure approval, not a building permit, CO, or proof of energization.
actions.access_caveat: Official order PDF was text-extracted; it establishes the utility certificate and QTS customer identity but not building completion or service date.
actions.evidence_note: Utility/regulator action kept separate from land-use and building approval.
